name: ByteIT
tagline: Automate the busywork. Focus on growing your business.
source: https://byteit.com/ home page, sampled with templates/brand-probe.js on 2026-10-14

dna.paletteNotes: Royal blue (#0530C0) is the most used brand color on the site: links, borders and full-width bands. The main call-to-action button ("Schedule a Free Consultation") uses a darker red-orange, #C5310D. The video keeps #F5831F as the accent and #E02B1F for alert states; use #C5310D if an on-screen button is shown.
typography: Site: H1 48 px / 500, H2 30 px / 600, body 18 px / 300 with 1.6 line height, nav 17 px / 600
Video: headings scale up to 62-88 px / 700 for 1080p legibility; body copy stays light (300)
dna.logoNotes: Wordmark "byte" in navy with an orange square and orange and red dots, plus "Byte IT" below. Only a 219x119 PNG is published; ask the design team for an SVG.
motifs: Orange hand-drawn swoosh under key heading words
Large light-gray circular arc behind hero content
White cards with soft navy shadows
Orange and red dots from the logo
dna.toneOfVoice: A reassuring, plain-spoken IT partner for small and mid-size businesses. Leads with trust and time given back, not with jargon or fear.
headlineSamples: Streamlining Your IT, Enabling Rapid & Scalable Business Growth
Don't Let IT Challenges Hold You Back!
do: Do lead with the business outcome: time back, growth, peace of mind
Do talk to the viewer as "you" and "your business"
Do use concrete numbers from the source document
doNot: Don't put more than two accent colors in one scene
Don't stretch, recolor or crop the logo
